comments.value:
Launch: Respawn moved, pissed me off for a week, why is camera shortcut gone? Why was the full emotes list replaced with a clone of the avatar interactions setting? Shouldn't this just be part of safe mode? why the huge banner thing, but no ingame detailed changelogs or news section, players are expected to make an account on a third-party platform (Discord) to get the news on the game, its nonsensical.
Notifications: Why can I not see the details page for a world when I'm being invited? Why do I have to wait for the entire close animation for the click action to confirm on elements? if I click the ✅ and quickly close the menu after, the invite request is still there after reopening the menu and going back to notifications, and it never sent.
Here: I use this a lot, and I bet many others do. I love being able to have a quick glance at who is in the instance without looking super sus, I like being able to see the user count, instance type, being able to rejoin quickly. Here tab stays, and its pretty good. (though, why do I have to click on the world thumbnail specifically to get the full page instead of being able to click the entire world card?)
Camera: yeah, this tab sure feels useless, but if it had a viewer to check pictures you've taken, either locally, or to your vrc+ gallery, it would be nice.
audio: this tab is fine, considering how audio is one of TWO senses you have in VR, quick control over the experience at all time is important. I change voice and world volume all the time myself.
Settings: It's okay, UI 2.0 will come eventually, the team has reiterated multiple times that this is hellscape is temporary.
I think scrolling through pages is okay, the settings tab feels a little extreme now, but scrolling through here or audio seems fine to me.
I agree the action menu, and especially everything under settings in the root menu is absolutely ridiculous, some things need to be moved out of there into some other way of accessing them.
I also thought just now, the action menu could let you go back simply by clicking the trigger while no option is selected, which would make it easier and faster to back out of submenus.
getting all of this game's features to work well, make sense in context and not be clunky is more than a matter of reorganization, some real head scratching has to be done on UX. definitely not right now, considering the rate at which new features, settings and toggles are being pushed into the game...

details:
In the absence of the rest of the new UI, the quick menu is becoming very cluttered.

The "Launch" and "Notifications" tabs are good. No complaints there.

The "Here" tab isn't really that important for quick access (I practically never use it) and its functions could possibly just be moved to the upcoming full menu redesign. This is one of the tabs that always has a scrollbar, which I think is bad.

The functions of the "Camera" tab could be moved to the camera itself and then folded into a button on the Launch tab. I find that I want to bring up the camera in one click, and the hidden functionality where you can double-click the Camera tab to bring up the camera is a kludgy solution.

The functionality in the "Audio" tab is useful but duplicated elsewhere in the UI. It's a good place for the Earmuff Mode setting, though, so I'm not sure it should be removed outright. That said, this tab also always has a scrollbar, which I think is bad.

The "Settings" tab has no clear theme; it is a dumping ground for every setting that doesn't fit into other categories and has three pages worth of options crammed into a small box menu with a scrollbar. This is why scrollbars are bad in the quick menu: two thirds of the options aren't even visible when you first switch to the tab. This tab is the most egregious offender for why the quick menu can no longer be considered "quick".

Some of the problems with the quick menu leak over into the radial menu, which now has too many radial sub-menus that are impossible to commit to muscle memory. The personal mirror also probably shouldn't be there given the way VRChat's UI is categorised and designed (hell, put it on the Camera tab instead), but I imagine that if it were somewhere else it would have contributed to even more clutter. You have to back out of a truly ridiculous amount of sub-menus to get back to avatar expressions from the personal mirror menu.
title: The Quick Menu is becoming very cluttered
